paper_metadata.title: Effects of heat treatment on microstructure evolution and mechanical properties of Ti–22Al–24Nb-0.5Mo alloy

evidence.section: Abstract
evidence.quote: In this study, microstructure evolution, tensile and fracture behaviors of Ti – 22Al – 24Nb-0.5Mo alloy processed under different heat treatment processing routes were investigated systematically.

evidence.section: 3.1. Microstructure characterization
evidence.quote: Fig. 2 (a) exhibits optical micrograph of the as-forged microstructure, which consists of the coarse elongated B2 grains with average grain size of ~700 μ m and aspect ratios of ~2.0.
The volume fractions of these O phases were measured to be approximately 75%, the rest is B2 matrix with volume fraction of 25%.
Furthermore, bimodal size distribution of lamellar O phase and a few coarse equiaxed O phases were precipitated within the B2 grains with a random orientation.

the finer lamellar O phases were precipitated during the gradual cooling to room temperature after forging, which were unstable and easily re-dissolved into the B2 matrix during the subsequent heat treatment.
